title: Form 425 multi-document public acquisition proposal package
filingText: Filed pursuant to Rule 425. Filed by: Example Buyer Corp. Subject Company: Example Target Inc. The following written communications are attached.

attachments.text:
PUBLIC ACQUISITION PROPOSAL
Example Buyer Corp. proposes to acquire all outstanding shares of Example Target Inc. for $42.00 per share in cash.
The proposal is subject to confirmatory due diligence and negotiation of a definitive merger agreement.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Example Buyer Publicly Proposes to Acquire Example Target
The proposed cash consideration represents a 35% premium to the unaffected closing price.

INVESTOR PRESENTATION
Transaction Overview
Offer Price | $42.00 per share
Implied Equity Value | $5.1 billion
Strategic Rationale
The combination would expand the buyer's marketplace and payments platform.

TRANSACTION FACT SHEET
Metric | Proposed Term
Consideration | $42.00 per share in cash
Status | Public proposal; no definitive agreement signed
Next Step | Target board review
